versions.changelog:
- Initial release of **Debt Blitz Planner**.
- Compares debt payoff strategies: avalanche (highest APR first), snowball (smallest balance first), and minimum-only baseline.
- Provides exact debt-free dates, total interest paid, interest saved, and payoff schedules with real amortization calculations.
- Supports extra payment scenarios and monthly budget mode.
- Detects unsustainable minimum payments and offers clear warnings.
- Generates side-by-side comparisons and exportable schedules for all strategies.
